<thought>To find a suitable retrosynthetic template for the target molecule, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a ketone and a C‑C triple bond (as described in the hint) and form a new C‑C bond via a cycloaddition. This should return a template that can be used in a single-step retrosynthesis.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "C-C triple bond"],
  "functional_groups_formed": null,
  "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
  "bonds_broken": null,
  "bonds_order_changed": null,
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
